package: @astryxdesign/cli

## Integration themes

Install an integration and Astryx discovers its themes automatically. Import one with `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme add <name> --package <integration>`. Use `theme eject` only for an independent source fork. For the full walkthrough, see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs use-a-theme`.

Up: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs theme --index
Previous: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs theme light-dark-mode
stderr: Next step: run `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 init` to finish setup and install the Astryx agent prompt.
